title: qeelak addâ xexxaarak
intro: Qunxa roocih safar qimbisem caylale mabla qaran xagaritte massakaxxal qununna. ta numtin amoh mano asta luk sugte kaxxa gano too xayi marak, katayak liggiditteh naqoosa kee hoxat yan casbi. Usuk uxih qimmoh addah imaan kee diini miracsenta, ta ximmo addah tan booxal ugutteeh, kaxxa imperiyal kaxxa cayla le marak numuk teyna tekke. Atu ta assakat le Yallih taama abeynah kinnaane qaddossam duuddaa?
clues: Anu taban kee inki cutuktaay, ayroo kee alsa yok foocal sujuud akak yoo yuybulle.
Anu inni xaleenak kaxxam kicna awkak sugeeh, yi toobokoh fanat aysinu bahte
Anu inni tooboko tibbixeh, sartan yok qanxiseh, tite le qeeli fan qide
Anu qadaagah aracal uwwaytih innal limmoyseh sugeeh, inni baaxok alla quukak suge
caylale barra yi kunnabna salcissam gabbatteeh, anu tet maysaasa cineemih taagah casbit qiden
Anu soono maqnissoh acwat barkat geeh, habbaale casbik Masrik naharsi malaak fan ugte

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Inki num isi toobokoh gabat addah yan qeeli fan qida
Qeebi booxal kaxxa gaadule luk qeebi abaanam
trial.answer: Inki num isi toobokoh gabat addah yan qeeli fan qida

location.label: Lafa le liyyitte
options: Bacari addat addah tan kafin qeeli
Qalek amot tan kaxxa coox doonik
location.answer: Bacari addat addah tan kafin qeeli

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Masrik naharsi malaak akkuk kicinto buxah marat yangoorowe
Kaxxa markab xisak ummatta imaanal secte.
Masril inkih tan agat naqoosak yayyaaqeenim
Ambullee waytaamih amoytiinu kee amoytiinu yomcowweh suge
outcome.answer: Masrik naharsi malaak akkuk kicinto buxah marat yangoorowe

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
